name: Accordion
description: A vertically stacked set of disclosure sections that open with a smooth height animation and a spring-rotating chevron or plus icon. Supports single or multiple open items, separated, bordered or ghost styles, and controlled or uncontrolled state.
a11yNotes: Follows the WAI-ARIA Accordion pattern: each header is a native button inside a heading (level configurable) with aria-expanded and aria-controls; each open panel is a role=region labelled by its header. Enter/Space toggle, ArrowUp/ArrowDown move between headers (wrapping) and Home/End jump to the first/last, skipping disabled items. In single, non-collapsible mode the open header reports aria-disabled. Closed panels are unmounted so their content leaves the tab order. Reduced motion opens panels instantly.
